items.title: Live: Socceroos kick off in World Cup opener after selection shock
items.description: The Socceroos begin their 2026 World Cup journey in Vancouver with their opening Group D match against a talented Türkiye. Follow live.

items.title: Paddleboarder says shark attack victim he helped save was 'very unlucky'
items.description: An off-duty volunteer lifeguard who pulled a woman from the ocean after she was bitten by a shark reveals how he helped save her life while in a state of "panic" himself.

items.title: As the US marks defeating a king, Trump consumes Washington
items.description: Project by project, Donald Trump is altering the United States capital, and in some cases, disrupting views and design that date back more than two centuries.

items.title: No Medicare, no family, no visa — these are the babies Australia doesn't count
items.description: For the Pacific Islander women who harvest the fruit and vegetables that stock Australia’s supermarket shelves, motherhood here can mean injury, debt, secrecy and fear.

items.title: 'No regrets about pulling up stumps': Liberal frontbencher Jonno Duniam to retire
items.description: Senator Duniam says it is time to prioritise his family after 25 years in politics, and he will leave his position in the Senate by the end of this year.

items.title: Anna thought she had a job in a hotel. Instead, she was trapped in a scam compound
items.description: Hundreds of trafficking survivors from Africa are left stranded in Cambodia amid a widespread crackdown on the country's scam compounds.

items.title: Breaking: Knicks end 53-year drought to win NBA championship
items.description: New York Knicks come from behind to defeat San Antonio Spurs 94-90 in Game 5 of the NBA Finals.

items.title: Live: Tigers, Lions locked in tight tussle in Hobart ahead of Giants-Saints clash
items.description: The Tigers host Brisbane in Hobart, before the Saints and Giants clash at Docklands to bring round 14 of the AFL to a close. Follow live.

items.title: Butler open to NDIS changes but convinced it's heading in 'right direction'
items.description: Health Minister Mark Butler is open to adjusting the proposed National Disability Insurance Scheme changes, but insists the government is on the right track.

items.title: Nine-year-old Perth girl shot dead by police in Pakistan
items.description: A nine-year-old Perth girl has been fatally shot by police in Pakistan after officers mistook her family's car for that of suspected criminals.

items.title: Love story: When these childhood friends reunited, the spark was undeniable
items.description: It was a case of puppy love when Cambell first set eyes on Tiana at a Gold Coast housing complex when they were both nine years old. They lost touch when they entered their teens but reunited as adults and have been inseparable since.

items.title: Meet the Brisbane couple who have donated more than $100 million to charity
items.description: Quentin and Kylie Birt say they were inspired to donate at the Big Freeze event after reading Neale Daniher's book.

items.title: Thousands rally in Belfast to condemn anti-immigrant rioting
items.description: The anti-racism rally came after nights of fiery violence in parts of Northern Ireland following the arrest of a 30-year-old man from Sudan on charges of attempted murder in a stabbing that left a man partly blind.

items.title: The feminist and the bra fitter: Inside the world of Hannah Ferguson and her mum
items.description: Emerging media star Hannah Ferguson and her mum, professional bra fitter Phillipa Mitchell, have found themselves on a similar path of empowering women, but just don't expect them to see it that way.

items.title: Tinariwen deliver songs of hope from a homeland in crisis
items.description: Legendary African band Tinariwen say there’s very little hope for their country. It just makes their dedication to music more important.

items.title: Can you soar to the top of this week's spelling quiz?
items.description: From homophones to Aussie bird names, Guy Montgomery's Spelling Bee quiz is set to test and teach in equal measure.

items.title: Some think Britain's 'broken', and they are looking to Australia for inspiration
items.description: Right-wing populism is rising in the UK where, like Australia, the political landscape is looking very different lately. It has prompted some people to ask if these surging parties can deliver on their promises.

items.title: Brisbane to get $5.6m boost to health and wellness programs
items.description: The Move Well Brisbane campaign will double the number of providers and activities in Brisbane's Active and Healthy program and include nutritional and cooking classes.

items.title: The multi-million-dollar tourist hotspot where locals can't afford to live
items.description: A tourist hotspot with skyrocketing rents, low rental vacancies and a dearth of public housing, has found a way to help find homes for those who can't afford to live in their own region.

items.title: 'Who will be accountable for this?': Families grieve sailors killed in Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Families of Indian sailors who died in a US military attack in the Strait of Hormuz want to know who is accountable for attacks on commercial vessels.

items.title: King Charles's celebrates official birthday with Trooping the Colour
items.description: Members of the royal family attend the king's annual birthday parade in London.

items.title: Hundreds of regional firefighters rally against levy in Bendigo
items.description: Hundreds of regional Victorian firefighters turn out for a rally in Bendigo, calling on the state government to scrap a controversial levy after saying they have been "left behind".

items.title: 'We have all got Tino's back': Maroons rally around mourning star
items.description: Tino Fa'asuamaleaui indicates he plans to play in Origin II after the death of his father this week.

items.title: Here's what you need to know about the KPMG scandal
items.description: Accounting firm KPMG is engulfed in a scandal that has seen several senior leaders quit and ASIC launch an investigation into the firm's business dealings.

items.title: Former potato farm given new life as bird sanctuary
items.description: Once drained for farm irrigation, this former potato farm now attracts birds from as far away as Siberia.
